evidence.notes: identifier/ontology_id CHEBI:9532 -> kgmicrobe.ingredient:0_2_thiamine_pyrophosphate. This record is a 0.2% stock SOLUTION, not the pure compound, and it was holding CHEBI:9532 ('thiamine(1+) diphosphate') — the term the pure-compound record needs. #288 established that stock solutions take a kgmicrobe.ingredient: identifier with FALLBACK_REGISTRY; this applies that rule and frees the ChEBI term. Its recorded CAS 154-87-0 is the chloride's, so that field was never evidence for the ChEBI term either.
